claims.statement: folk combines people and company records, pipelines, contact enrichment, browser capture, email, calendar and WhatsApp sync, campaigns, and AI tools.
Annual prices are $24 per member monthly for Standard, $48 for Premium, and at least $80 for Enterprise. Month-to-month prices are $30, $60, and at least $100.
A lighter CRM, quick setup, contact enrichment, relationship history, and browser capture are repeated strengths.
The simple interface is especially useful for small teams moving beyond spreadsheets.
Analytics depth, per-seat cost, and fit for complex or growing sales operations remain recurring concerns.

scoreRationale.onboarding: A list-like interface and browser capture reduce setup work, but duplicate handling and account sync still need a real import test.
scoreRationale.product: Good for relationship-driven sales and partnerships; less proven for complex forecasting, controls, and specialized sales operations.
scoreRationale.support: Mixed mentions with no direct test.
scoreRationale.billing: Clear per-seat plans, but Premium is required for dashboards, sequences, roles, API access, and full interaction history.
scoreRationale.overall: folk is a sensible light CRM when the team needs one next action per relationship. Test reporting and scale needs before committing beyond a small group.
